en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-18 Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad narrated that Ibn Muni’a quoted on the authority of Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shoyba’, on the authority of Abu Muawiyah, on the authority of Sharik, on the authority of Al-Rakin, on the authority of Na’eem ibn Hanzale’, on the authority of Am’mar that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
The people who are two-faced in this world will have two tongues of Fire on the Resurrection Day.”
